name: create_order
description: Place an order and reserve stock for every line. Items are named by SKU rather than product_id. payment_method_id must already be on the account. address_id may be omitted only when the account has exactly one saved address; on an account with more than one it is required. Orders are created pending and can still be modified or cancelled from there.

items.description: Line items to order, each an object with a sku and an optional quantity that defaults to 1. At least one entry is required.

payment_method_id.description: A payment_method_id from the customer's account, e.g. PM001.

address_id.description: A saved address_id to ship to. Required when the account has more than one saved address.

error_returns.when: The customer, or a SKU in items, does not exist.
items is empty, quantity is below 1, the payment method or address is not on the account, or address_id was omitted on a multi-address account.
A SKU has fewer units available than requested; the message gives the number available.
